pack.name: The narrator
pack.note: Never named aloud; the player writes a name in the guestbook.

groups.name: Group A, the first new guests
groups.source_note: The source gives only "three of them, young, laughing, unaware" (ch 19); names and lives are added.

members.name: Omar
members.interior: Organised this reunion; first trip with the old school friends in eight years.

members.name: Bea
members.interior: Laughs easily, hides that she is nervous of the woods. Sleeps lightly.
members.habit: Picks up Jamie and puts him on the couch (ch 19-20).

members.name: Sunny
members.interior: Brought a scrapbook of their old trips.
members.habit: Shows the scrapbook to the others on the rug, right below your shelf.

lines.text: Look at us. We look twelve.

members.name: Noor
members.interior: Has taken a job abroad and came to tell the other two; rehearses it at the bathroom mirror; afraid of being the one who leaves.
members.carried_habit: Her hum is the pitch of the I6 giggle in the next run.

lines.text: I swear I locked that door.

members.name: Wes
members.interior: Ana's brother; jokes all the time; still afraid of the dark since a childhood power cut, sleeps with a lamp on and hides it.
learnable: Photographs the toys with a film camera
members.carried_habit: His camera strap's fabric is the warm bear's collar (I4) in the next run.

members.name: Ana
members.interior: First trip after a hard year she never names; afraid of being a burden.
learnable: Lifts Lila to sit beside a bear "so she isn't alone" (ch 25)
members.carried_habit: Her toy faces the window "so it isn't alone" in the next run.

members.name: Sol
members.interior: Retired teacher, birdwatcher; on his fortieth anniversary; losing his hearing and hiding it.
learnable: First to notice the silence ("No birds.")

members.name: Rosa
members.interior: Sketches the toys every morning; lost in a wood as a girl.

members.name: Kit
members.interior: Their daughter, a night-shift nurse, here to mend years of distance.

lines.text: I swear I locked that door.

carried_incidents.note: In run 2 and later, four Act 1 incidents are done by last run's guests in their forms. The toy each incident needs is fixed by the source, so a guest's form is chosen by slot to fit them.
